description: Pray Production Studio helps you turn creative ideas into AI video projects. Search your PPS projects, view project details, plan trailers, and render trailer videos from ChatGPT. Video generation uses credits in your PPS workspace, and the tools available depend on your account access and enabled providers.

Turn this script scene into Kling or Seedance video prompts. I’ll attach reference images, use them to guide the visuals.
